_comment: Instagram publishing limits. Default 1 post per Asia/Bangkok day. The launch burst (approved by Artem 28.10.2026) allows 3/day with >= 3h between posts until the date below, to fill the first 9-post grid; after that the default applies automatically. The x block is for X (Twitter), scripts/publish-x.mjs: perDay main posts per Asia/Bangkok day, minHoursBetween posts, maxAgeDays = only carousels published on Instagram within this many days are cross-posted (keep it below prune-out's 14 days, after which the slides leave the working tree), reply = post the coloprice.com link as a reply (Post: Create with a URL is billed ~13x a plain post).
